description: Python finite-element workflows built on FEniCSx for humans and AI agents: structural mechanics, heat transfer, simulation campaigns, and simulation-to-learning workflows.
rules: Use the documented public Python API and structured CLI; do not invent methods or rely on private DOLFINx objects.
Use a compatible FEniCSx/DOLFINx environment as documented in INSTALL.md; installing a Python package alone does not install the complete numerical runtime.
Start with physical Study factories, named regions, and model.step(target=...). Keep material, load, constraint, and output declarations distinct.
Distinguish an executed simulation from a verified or experimentally validated result. Inspect convergence, applicability, and benchmark evidence.
Keep surrogates, neural operators, and neural-field solvers distinct. Check the installed version and optional dependencies against the current reference.
